user.title: Select your ESPHome deck
user.description: Select the already paired ESPHome device. Setup verifies runtime signatures and capabilities through HA's existing connection. v1 supports basic tiles; v2 adds positioning, verified address setup and safe pages.

handoff.title: Hand over layout and bindings
handoff.description: ESP Deck will own all 15 visuals. Stop other visual writers and duplicate key automations. Selected automations will be turned off (including running actions); the three shipped P4 helper scripts will be stopped. Their YAML is preserved. Optionally bind key 0 to an entity. Open ESP Deck in the sidebar to edit keys and artwork. For v2, verify the reachable HA artwork address in Configure → Artwork address or the editor's Library settings. v1 requires its compiled origin.

data.exclusive_control: I have stopped competing visual writers and duplicate bindings
data.label: Key 0 label

reconfigure.title: Replace the ESPHome association
reconfigure.description: Choose the compatible replacement. Existing layouts are preserved. Stop any manual replay and duplicate bindings on the replacement before continuing.

init.title: Configure ESP Deck
init.description: [Open the visual editor](/esp-deck) to edit keys, bindings and artwork. Advanced preset and entity-mapping tools remain below.

artwork.title: Verify the artwork address
artwork.description: Enter the HA address reachable from the ESP, including scheme and port. v2 tests a PNG fetch on the device before saving its exact allowlist. HTTPS keeps certificate, hostname and clock checks. v1 firmware must already allow the address. A browser address or localhost may be unreachable from the deck.

binding.title: Set an entity preset
binding.description: Replace one key in the draft with a light/switch toggle or script/scene action. On/off/unavailable feedback follows actual HA state. Applying activates the whole saved draft. Use the ESP Deck sidebar for the visual editor.

data.key: Key (0–14, front view, left to right)
data.label: Label

repair.title: Repair entity mapping
repair.description: Select the existing ESPHome session and edge entities. Enable disabled entities first. HA renames are followed automatically. Each event must belong to this deck and support press/release.
